name: Camera bracelet for finding lost items

mentions.name: Camera bracelet for finding lost items
mentions.description: A wearable bracelet with a tiny camera pointed at the wearer's palm that transmits pictures of held items and where they were set down locally to a phone. The pictures are processed by a quantized CLIP model, letting the wearer search for anything they have lost without attaching an AirTag to it. It works decently well, is aimed at 'power losers' such as people with ADHD-I, and includes a privacy slider with nothing sent to the cloud.
mentions.problem: Finding misplaced belongings is hard without attaching a tracker like an AirTag to everything.
mentions.source_excerpt: - A bracelet with tiny camera that's pointed at your hand palm and transmits pictures of the stuff you're holding and where you've put it down locally to your phone. Works decently well and is great for 'power losers' like those with ADHD-I. Has a privacy slider and nothing goes to the cloud.
